test_title: PYST 53: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held on 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
A cube is made by folding the given sheet. In the cube so formed, which letter will be on the face opposite to the face having 'F'?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c18ea814f7ec08c4ae032a3f96296c7748de16d473aa9d81e9b73a6bf60a9ef2.png]
solution:
From the given open dice:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2649d0683afdd62a464e801d0786a211556b55e579f04ac01c645add91bff1ed.png] 

A and C are the opposite faces.

E and B are the opposite faces.

D and F are the opposite faces.

So, **D** will be opposite to** F.**

Hence, the correct answer is ***'Option 1'.***
